text_simplified: The text discusses a tarbiyah-related story highlighting the importance of patience and self-control when dealing with children. The hadith narrates an incident involving Al-Hasan ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with them both, where the Prophet ﷺ demonstrated forbearance and rifq (gentleness) in addressing a child's behavior. From this, we learn the necessity of guiding children with kindness and avoiding anger or impatience.
